name: Sir Auden Valebright
ability_1_desc: All friendly Knights adjacent to Sir Auden Valebright add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Auden Valebright adds 2 dice.
design_note: A clean beatstick whose aura only pays off in a Knight-heavy army, so its value swings with the rest of the roster.

name: Sir Auden Valebright (variant)
ability_1_desc: All friendly Knights adjacent to Sir Auden Valebright add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Auden Valebright adds 2 dice.
ability_3_desc: Sir Auden Valebright cannot move and attack on the same turn. After revealing an Order Marker on this card, you must choose either to move Sir Auden Valebright up to his Move Value or to attack with Sir Auden Valebright, but not both.
design_note: Losing move-and-attack guts a Range 1 figure's offense entirely, but the aura and defensive power still function while he holds ground, making the discount hard to size.

name: Sszorak The Venomtongue
ability_1_desc: After attacking a figure with a normal attack, if that figure received at least 1 wound and was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 additional wound.
ability_2_desc: Sszorak the Venomtongue does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space. Add 1 to Sszorak the Venomtongue's Defense Value while he is on a water space.
design_note: Attack 5 with a 35% bonus-wound rider is a high damage ceiling on only Defense 3 and 5 Life, so offense and fragility nearly cancel out.

name: Sszorak The Venomtongue (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking a figure with a normal attack, if that figure received at least 1 wound and was not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 additional wound.
ability_2_desc: Sszorak the Venomtongue does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space. Add 1 to Sszorak the Venomtongue's Defense Value while he is on a water space.
ability_3_desc: At the end of every round, Sszorak the Venomtongue receives 1 wound. Sszorak the Venomtongue cannot be healed or have wounds removed by any special power or glyph.
design_note: A guaranteed wound each round turns 5 Life into a four-round clock that no healing can reset, so the drawback scales with how long the game lasts.

name: Deadeye Unit ZR-9
ability_1_desc: If Deadeye Unit ZR-9 does not move on its turn, add 1 die to its attack and opponent's figures roll 1 fewer defense die when defending against ZR-9's attack that turn.
ability_2_desc: When Deadeye Unit ZR-9 attacks a non-adjacent Unique Hero, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
design_note: Two stacking ranged riders can turn a plain 4 attack into a Hero-killing 5 attack that strips two defense dice, which is easy to underprice at range 7.

name: Deadeye Unit ZR-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Deadeye Unit ZR-9 (variant) does not move on its turn, add 1 die to its attack and opponent's figures roll 1 fewer defense die when defending against ZR-9 (variant)'s attack that turn.
ability_2_desc: When Deadeye Unit ZR-9 (variant) attacks a non-adjacent Unique Hero, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Deadeye Unit ZR-9 (variant), before taking a turn with it, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent of your choice takes ZR-9 (variant)'s entire turn instead of you, moving and attacking with ZR-9 (variant) as if it were their own figure, and may attack figures you control.
ability_4_desc: Deadeye Unit ZR-9 (variant) is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A 30% chance per activated turn of handing a range 7 armor-piercing sniper to the opponent is a swingy drawback only partly offset by the added Disengage.

name: Vaelith Skywarden
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one additional figure within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Storm Lance Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Vaelith Skywarden, you may choose one small or medium figure you control that is adjacent to Vaelith Skywarden and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty space within 3 spaces of Vaelith Skywarden. That space may be up to 8 levels higher or lower. If you roll a 10 or lower, nothing happens. A figure moved by Thermal Lift 11 does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Skywarden's movement, ignore elevations. Vaelith Skywarden may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Skywarden starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying plus a two-target ranged special attack and a friendly repositioning d20 power stack three different kinds of value onto a fragile 4-life frame.

name: Vaelith Skywarden (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one additional figure within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Storm Lance Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Vaelith Skywarden (variant), you may choose one small or medium figure you control that is adjacent to Vaelith Skywarden (variant) and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, place the chosen figure on any empty space within 3 spaces of Vaelith Skywarden (variant). That space may be up to 8 levels higher or lower. If you roll a 10 or lower, nothing happens. A figure moved by Thermal Lift 11 does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelith Skywarden (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. Vaelith Skywarden (variant) may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Vaelith Skywarden (variant) starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: If there is at least one Wound Marker on this Army Card, Vaelith Skywarden (variant) cannot use her Flying special power.
design_note: The drawback only activates after the first wound lands, so its cost depends on how reliably a 4-life, 3-defense flyer avoids being hit at all.

name: Grintuk Tunnelrats
ability_1_desc: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with a Grintuk Tunnelrat, you may add 3 to your die roll. When a Grintuk Tunnelrat you control picks up a Treasure Glyph, you may immediately move that Tunnelrat up to 2 spaces.
ability_2_desc: While a Grintuk Tunnelrat you control occupies a glyph, that Tunnelrat adds 1 to its defense dice, and all other Grintuk Tunnelrats you control within 4 clear sight spaces of that glyph add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_3_desc: A Grintuk Tunnelrat may move through and end its movement on any space occupied by a small figure you control. Grintuk Tunnelrats never have to stop their movement when entering a space adjacent to an opponent's figure, but they will take leaving engagement attacks normally.
design_note: A cheap 4-figure common squad whose entire defensive package is conditional on standing on glyphs, making its value swing wildly with the map's glyph count.

name: Grintuk Tunnelrats (variant)
ability_1_desc: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with a Grintuk Tunnelrat (variant), you may add 3 to your die roll. When a Grintuk Tunnelrat (variant) you control picks up a Treasure Glyph, you may immediately move that Tunnelrat up to 2 spaces.
ability_2_desc: While a Grintuk Tunnelrat (variant) you control occupies a glyph, that Tunnelrat adds 1 to its defense dice, and all other Grintuk Tunnelrats (variant) you control within 4 clear sight spaces of that glyph add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_3_desc: A Grintuk Tunnelrat (variant) may move through and end its movement on any space occupied by a small figure you control. Grintuk Tunnelrats (variant) never have to stop their movement when entering a space adjacent to an opponent's figure, but they will take leaving engagement attacks normally.
ability_4_desc: Grintuk Tunnelrats (variant) are never affected by the special power of any glyph they occupy, and they may not pick up or carry Treasure Glyphs. They may still occupy glyph spaces.
design_note: The added drawback turns off one of the card's own powers and halves another, so the discount must be larger than a generic 'no glyphs' penalty.

name: Kragmar Boarmen
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Kragmar Boarmen, you may first take a turn with any Orc or Beast Unique Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: If a Kragmar Boarman moves at least 4 spaces before attacking an adjacent figure, add 1 to its Attack Value for that attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, a Kragmar Boarman adds 1 to its defense dice.
design_note: Bonding plus a conditional attack bonus on a cheap 4-figure melee squad pushes it well above the usual attack 3 / defense 2 baseline.

name: Kragmar Boarmen (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with Kragmar Boarmen, you may first take a turn with any Orc or Beast Unique Hero you control.
ability_2_desc: If a Kragmar Boarman moves at least 4 spaces before attacking an adjacent figure, add 1 to its Attack Value for that attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, a Kragmar Boarman adds 1 to its defense dice.
ability_4_desc: Whenever a Kragmar Boarman moves, it must end its movement on a space adjacent to another friendly figure, if possible.
design_note: Forced clustering barely hurts a swarm squad in the open but interacts badly with its own charge power and with area special attacks, a subtle discount.

name: Rimehide Ravager
ability_1_desc: Before taking a turn with a Rimehide Ravager, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, the opponent to your left takes that turn with this Rimehide Ravager instead. That opponent may move and attack with this Rimehide Ravager as if it were their own figure.
ability_2_desc: When a Rimehide Ravager attacks, it must attack the figure closest to it, even a figure you control. If two or more figures are tied for closest, you choose which of those figures the Ravager attacks.
ability_3_desc: If a Rimehide Ravager inflicts one or more wounds on a figure with a normal attack, that figure subtracts 2 from its Move Value until the end of the round.
ability_4_desc: A Rimehide Ravager never takes falling damage and may climb up or down up to 6 levels of height in a single space of movement.
design_note: Life 6, Move 7 and Attack 5 on an uncommon hero is Warhulk territory, but a 20% chance per turn that the opponent drives the beast (and the forced nearest-figure targeting they can exploit) can turn it into a liability inside your own lines.

name: Tovak Strand, Powder Marshal
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Grapeshot Barrage Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures you control are not affected by Grapeshot Barrage Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: Tovak Strand may not attack on a turn in which he has moved. If you move Tovak Strand, his turn ends.
ability_3_desc: After attacking with Grapeshot Barrage Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, place one Wound Marker on this Army Card.
ability_4_desc: If Tovak Strand did not move on his turn and is on a road space or a ruin space, add 1 to his Attack Value for Grapeshot Barrage Special Attack.
design_note: A friendly-fire-free Attack 4 area barrage at range 6 is very strong on paper, but Move 4 combined with never being able to move and attack, plus a 25% self-wound on a 4-life body, makes his positioning nearly one-shot.

name: Thessa Windshorn
ability_1_desc: If Thessa Windshorn moved 6 or more spaces this turn and attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below Thessa Windshorn's base, add 2 to Thessa Windshorn's Attack Value for that attack.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, the opponent to your left must move Thessa Windshorn up to 4 spaces. When counting spaces for this move, ignore elevations. Thessa Windshorn is never attacked when leaving an engagement during Gale Drift, and may not be moved onto a space she could not otherwise occupy. Thessa Windshorn may take falling damage from Gale Drift.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Thessa Windshorn's movement, ignore elevations. Thessa Windshorn may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Thessa Windshorn is engaged when she starts to fly, she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: When rolling defense dice for Thessa Windshorn against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: Move 9 stealth flying with a height-based Attack 6 dive is elite mobility, but handing an opponent a free 4-space reposition of her every round lets them pull her out of position, off height, or over a drop.

name: Cinderpitch Bombardiers
ability_1_desc: After a Cinderpitch Bombardier attacks, and after all wounds from that attack have been resolved, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, destroy that Cinderpitch Bombardier.
ability_2_desc: A Cinderpitch Bombardier cannot move and attack in the same turn. If a Cinderpitch Bombardier moves at all during its turn, it may not attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: If a Cinderpitch Bombardier inflicts one or more wounds on a figure or destructible object, that figure or destructible object reduces its Defense Value by 1 until the next time any player reveals an Order Marker.
design_note: Range 6 Attack 3 commons normally price near 100, but a 15% self-destruction chance on every shot and the inability to move and attack pull this card toward static-artillery pricing that is hard to pin down.

name: Ivrienne Thinveil
ability_1_desc: At the end of each round, after all Order Markers have been revealed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 5 or lower, destroy Ivrienne Thinveil. Ivrienne Thinveil's controlling player does not receive a wound or a kill for this destruction.
ability_2_desc: If Ivrienne Thinveil was unengaged when you began her turn, add 2 dice to her normal attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Ivrienne Thinveil's movement, ignore elevations. Ivrienne Thinveil may fly over water without stopping, over figures without becoming engaged, and over obstacles such as ruins. When Ivrienne Thinveil starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Ivrienne Thinveil is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Move 7 Stealth Flying with an Attack 6 opening strike is strong harassment, but a cumulative 25% chance of simply evaporating each round means her point value depends entirely on how many rounds you expect her to survive.

name: Unit 44 "Misfire"
ability_1_desc: Range 8. Attack 5. After attacking with Overcharged Rail Cannon Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or lower, place one Wound Marker on Unit 44 "Misfire".
ability_2_desc: When Unit 44 "Misfire" attacks with a normal attack or with Overcharged Rail Cannon Special Attack, it must target the figure nearest to it that it can see, friendly or not. If two or more figures that Unit 44 "Misfire" can see are equally near, you choose which of those figures to target.
ability_3_desc: When Unit 44 "Misfire" rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, add 1 die to its defense.
design_note: Range 8 Attack 5 artillery is worth a great deal, but Corrupted Targeting can force it to shoot its own army while a 45% recoil chance caps its total shots at roughly four, making the drawbacks nearly cancel the offense.

name: Vexna Scaleweaver
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Spore Cloud Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Vexna Scaleweaver, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from any Army Card you control.
design_note: Range 6 attack 3 plus a splash special attack and a low-odds army-wide heal make this hero straddle the line between artillery and support pricing.

name: Vexna Scaleweaver (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Spore Cloud Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Vexna Scaleweaver, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from any Army Card you control.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Vexna Scaleweaver add 1 to their Move Value. Vexna Scaleweaver is not affected by Skittering Cadence Aura.
design_note: A movement aura on a ranged hero who prefers to stay back is awkward to use, so the aura adds less value here than the same aura would on a front-line figure.

name: Sentinel Unit VX-11
ability_1_desc: Before moving with Sentinel Unit VX-11, you may choose one Soulborg you control that is adjacent to him. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen Soulborg's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Sentinel Unit VX-11 never rolls for falling damage, and he may not be moved or placed on another space by an opponent's special power.
design_note: Low move and a 25% heal on a Large height-6 frame make the base card unremarkable, so nearly all of the pair's price gap must come from the aura.

name: Sentinel Unit VX-11 (variant)
ability_1_desc: Before moving with Sentinel Unit VX-11, you may choose one Soulborg you control that is adjacent to him. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from the chosen Soulborg's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Sentinel Unit VX-11 never rolls for falling damage, and he may not be moved or placed on another space by an opponent's special power.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Sentinel Unit VX-11 add 1 die to their defense rolls. Sentinel Unit VX-11 is not affected by Aegis Projector Aura.
design_note: This aura ignores general and species entirely, so it buffs any army and is worth far more than a faction-locked version of the same power.

name: Blightwing Skirmisher
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Blightwing Skirmisher's movement, ignore elevations. A Blightwing Skirmisher may fly over water without stopping, may pass over figures without becoming engaged, and may fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Blightwing Skirmisher is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: When a Blightwing Skirmisher is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Blightwing Skirmisher receives 1 wound.
design_note: A 1-life flying common hero with a death-trigger is cheap individually, but players field four or more copies, so small pricing errors multiply.

name: Blightwing Skirmisher (variant)
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Blightwing Skirmisher's movement, ignore elevations. A Blightwing Skirmisher may fly over water without stopping, may pass over figures without becoming engaged, and may fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Blightwing Skirmisher is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: When a Blightwing Skirmisher is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Blightwing Skirmisher receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Marro figures within 4 clear sight spaces of a Blightwing Skirmisher add 1 to their Move Value. A figure may only be affected by one Swarm Cadence Aura at a time.
design_note: A movement aura printed on a fragile common hero is priced per figure, yet each extra copy re-issues the aura from a new angle, so the card must be costed as if the aura were nearly always active.

name: Vantiel Lancers
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking normally with the Vantiel Lancers, you may move each Vantiel Lancer you control up to 7 spaces. Vantiel Lancers may move through all opponent's Small and Medium figures during this movement and are never attacked when leaving an engagement. For each opponent's Small or Medium figure a Vantiel Lancer moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. A Vantiel Lancer may not end its movement on an occupied space.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Vantiel Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Hero you control who follows Einar.
design_note: Bonding plus a movement-based multi-hit special attack on a 3-figure unique squad stacks two high-variance value sources on top of one another.

name: Vantiel Lancers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking normally with the Vantiel Lancers, you may move each Vantiel Lancer you control up to 7 spaces. Vantiel Lancers may move through all opponent's Small and Medium figures during this movement and are never attacked when leaving an engagement. For each opponent's Small or Medium figure a Vantiel Lancer moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. A Vantiel Lancer may not end its movement on an occupied space.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Vantiel Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Hero you control who follows Einar.
design_note: With only a 20% wound chance the charge is mostly a repositioning and disengage tool, so the bonding carries the card.

name: Brother Calder Emberhand
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with Brother Calder Emberhand, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may remove up to 2 Wound Markers from any one Unique Hero you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Brother Calder Emberhand. If you roll a 7 or lower, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from Brother Calder Emberhand's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack for any figure you control who follows Jandar and is adjacent to Brother Calder Emberhand, add 1 die to the defense roll.
design_note: A reliable two-wound heal on any Unique Hero is worth far more per turn than his mediocre combat stats, and the consolation self-heal means the power never truly whiffs.

name: Brother Calder Emberhand (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with Brother Calder Emberhand, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove up to 2 Wound Markers from any one Unique Hero you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Brother Calder Emberhand. If you roll a 14 or lower, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from Brother Calder Emberhand's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dike against a normal attack for any figure you control who follows Jandar and is adjacent to Brother Calder Emberhand, add 1 die to the defense roll.
design_note: At only a 30% success rate the healer spends most order markers doing nothing but patching himself, so nearly all of the card's value collapses onto the defensive aura.

name: Deconstructor Prime
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Deconstructor Prime, you may roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to this Deconstructor Prime. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Pulse Discharge has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When this Deconstructor Prime attacks a destructible object, add 3 dice to its attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for this Deconstructor Prime against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: An uncommon hero that can field multiples makes the swarm-punishing pulse scale with the number of adjacent figures, so even a 30% threshold can snowball against squads.

name: Deconstructor Prime (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Deconstructor Prime, you may roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to this Deconstructor Prime. If you roll an 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Pulse Discharge has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When this Deconstructor Prime attacks a destructible object, add 3 dice to its attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for this Deconstructor Prime against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: At 65% per adjacent figure the pulse becomes a near-automatic multi-wound area attack before a 4-die swing, which is hard to price without over-rewarding an uncommon hero that can be taken in bulk.

name: Skarn Coldmaw
ability_1_desc: After attacking with Skarn Coldmaw's normal attack, if a Small or Medium figure was destroyed by that attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure that occupy a water space are also affected by Tidal Surge Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: Skarn Coldmaw may move through water spaces without stopping, and ignores all Water special powers on Army Cards and Glyphs. If Skarn Coldmaw begins its turn on a water space, add 1 die to Skarn Coldmaw's normal attack for that turn.
design_note: Eleven life plus repeated healing off squad kills gives near-limitless staying power, but the area attack and attack bonus are worthless on maps without water, making the price extremely terrain dependent.

name: Hurgrim the Pillar
ability_1_desc: On any turn you take with this Hurgrim the Pillar, you may either move with it or attack with it, but not both.
ability_2_desc: All Soldiers you control that are adjacent to this Hurgrim the Pillar add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: Any opponent's Small, Medium, or Large figure that moves adjacent to this Hurgrim the Pillar must immediately end its movement. This Hurgrim the Pillar may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
design_note: Defense 8 and a movement-stopping zone of control are premium wall traits, but Ponderous means it can almost never threaten anything, so the drawback may cancel most of the defensive premium.

name: Grokthar the Unbound
ability_1_desc: When moving with this Grokthar the Unbound, it may move through spaces occupied by Small or Medium figures without becoming engaged, but it may not end its movement on an occupied space. For each figure this Grokthar moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures affected by Trampling Charge cannot roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Grokthar the Unbound and before taking its turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or lower, your opponent takes this Grokthar's turn this turn instead of you.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, this Grokthar the Unbound subtracts 2 dice.
design_note: Twelve life with Attack 6 and free squad-shredding movement would be a top-tier beater, but a 20% chance of handing the turn to the opponent and a crippling penalty against ranged fire pull its value in opposite directions.

name: Vault Sentinel
ability_1_desc: A Vault Sentinel cannot move and attack on the same turn. If a Vault Sentinel moves at least one space on its turn, it cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to a Vault Sentinel you control roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: A Vault Sentinel is never affected by an opponent's special power that would move it or place it on another space. A Vault Sentinel cannot be carried and does not fall when a supporting figure is destroyed.
design_note: Defense 8 on a cheap Common Hero looks unbreakable, but never moving and attacking on the same turn makes it nearly harmless offensively.

name: Gorlomm the Mirewall
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure moves into a space adjacent to Gorlomm the Mirewall, that figure must end its movement there. Opponent's figures can never move through spaces adjacent to Gorlomm.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if Gorlomm the Mirewall occupies at least one water space, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Gorlomm the Mirewall does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces, and he never rolls for molten lava or other hazardous terrain damage on swamp water spaces.
design_note: Ten life and a total zone-of-control lock make him a devastating chokepoint holder, yet with only Range 1 and Move 4 he can be ignored entirely on open maps.

name: Bulwark Engine ARC-9
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. Bulwark Engine ARC-9 may use Siege Mortar Special Attack only if it did not move this turn. Choose a space within 6 clear sight spaces of ARC-9. The figure on that space and all figures adjacent to that space are affected by Siege Mortar Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: If Bulwark Engine ARC-9 did not move on its turn, add 2 to its Defense Value until the start of your next turn.
ability_3_desc: Bulwark Engine ARC-9 never rolls fewer than 3 defense dice against a special attack, and it is never affected by a special power that would lower its Defense Value.
design_note: It is either a Defense-9 immobile artillery piece or a Move-4 melee figure with no ranged option, and which mode the opponent allows determines nearly all of its worth.

name: Gorehound Unleashed
ability_1_desc: Gorehounds Unleashed do not start the game on the battlefield. Before taking a turn with a Bloodmaw Gorehound, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to remove that Bloodmaw Gorehound from the battlefield and place a Gorehound Unleashed on that space. Transfer all wound markers from the Bloodmaw Gorehound Army Card that belonged to that figure onto this Army Card. Take that turn with the Gorehound Unleashed.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with a Gorehound Unleashed, if it destroyed one or more figures this turn, you may immediately take another turn with that same Gorehound Unleashed. You may not use Blood Frenzy more than once each round.
ability_3_desc: When you take a turn with a Gorehound Unleashed, it must move as many spaces as possible toward the nearest enemy figure it can reach, and if it is engaged at the end of its movement, it must attack an adjacent enemy figure.
ability_4_desc: A Gorehound Unleashed may move up to 3 spaces through spaces occupied by other Beast figures you control.
design_note: Move 8 with a chained extra turn is explosive, but defense 1, forced targeting, and the one-order-marker cost of the swap pull hard in the other direction.

name: Talia Voss, Fractured
ability_1_desc: Talia Voss, Fractured does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Talia Voss, Chronowright and before taking a turn with her, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Talia Voss, Fractured figure on the space she occupied. Move all Order Markers on Talia Voss, Chronowright's Army Card to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers, and move all Wound Markers from that Army Card to this Army Card. You may then take a turn with Talia Voss, Fractured. If you roll a 1-10, take a turn with Talia Voss, Chronowright as normal.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Talia Voss, Fractured, you may reveal an unrevealed Order Marker on this Army Card. If you do, return that Order Marker face down to this Army Card and immediately take 1 additional turn with Talia Voss, Fractured. You may not use Rewind Special Power more than once per round.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, if Talia Voss, Fractured is on the battlefield, you must place 1 Wound Marker on this Army Card.
ability_4_desc: Talia Voss, Fractured can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A coin-flip entry, carried-over wounds, and a self-wounding clock fight against a repeatable extra-turn engine, so the add-on's real value depends entirely on how fast the game ends.

name: Kurosh, the Deepmaw
ability_1_desc: Kurosh, the Deepmaw does not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of any round, if Kurosh the Tidecaller occupies a water space, you may remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Kurosh, the Deepmaw figure on the space he occupied and any unoccupied adjacent spaces. Move all Order Markers on Kurosh the Tidecaller's Army Card to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers, and move all Wound Markers from that Army Card to this Army Card. Kurosh the Tidecaller cannot return to the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. All figures adjacent to Kurosh, the Deepmaw are affected by Engulf Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Figures on water spaces roll 1 fewer defense die against Engulf Special Attack.
ability_3_desc: If Kurosh, the Deepmaw is not on or adjacent to a water space at the start of his turn, subtract 2 from his Move Value and 1 from his Defense Value for that turn.
design_note: A Huge, 8-life, attack 6 body arriving as an add-on stretches the normal add-on ceiling, and its value swings wildly with how much water the map has.

name: Ashmaw Pyreborn
ability_1_desc: Ashmaw Pyreborn do not start the game on the battlefield. When an Ashmaw Prowler you control is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If the destroyed Ashmaw Prowler was on a lava field, molten lava, or road space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 14 or higher, place an Ashmaw Pyreborn figure on the space that Ashmaw Prowler occupied, if that space is unoccupied. You may never have more than 2 Ashmaw Pyreborn figures on the battlefield at one time. You may place Order Markers on this Army Card even if there are no Ashmaw Pyreborn figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmaw Pyreborn, roll the 20-sided die once for each opponent's figure it moved adjacent to this turn. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant or Lava Enhanced special power are not affected by Molten Wake.
ability_3_desc: This Ashmaw Pyreborn never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and does not have to stop on molten lava spaces. This Ashmaw Pyreborn cannot roll defense dice while it is on a water space.
design_note: An Uncommon Hero add-on whose quantity, timing, and total value all hinge on a 35%-or-better d20 roll per base figure death, with terrain swinging the odds.

name: Grimjaw the Unchained
ability_1_desc: Grimjaw the Unchained does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Grimjaw Ironhide's Army Card and before taking a turn with Grimjaw Ironhide, if Grimjaw Ironhide has 2 or more Wound Markers on his Army Card, you may remove Grimjaw Ironhide from the battlefield and place Grimjaw the Unchained on that space with 2 Wound Markers. Take a turn with Grimjaw the Unchained instead. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Grimjaw the Unchained, you may attack one additional time with Grimjaw the Unchained. The second attack must be against an adjacent figure. Grimjaw the Unchained rolls no more than 4 dice for the second attack.
ability_3_desc: At the end of a turn in which Grimjaw the Unchained did not inflict at least one wound, Grimjaw the Unchained receives 1 wound. If an opponent's figure adjacent to Grimjaw the Unchained attacks with a normal attack, it must attack Grimjaw the Unchained if it is able.
ability_4_desc: Grimjaw the Unchained may add 3 to his Move number as long as he is unengaged prior to moving. Grimjaw the Unchained must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Unchained Charge.
design_note: Enormous offense on defense 2 is paired with self-wounding and forced targeting, so the drawbacks may either cancel the upgrade or accelerate it depending on the opponent's army.

name: Shades of Nokthara
ability_1_desc: Shades of Nokthara do not start the game on the battlefield. When Nokthara the Sealed is destroyed, place all 3 Shades of Nokthara on the space Nokthara the Sealed occupied and on empty spaces adjacent to that space. Any unrevealed Order Markers on Nokthara the Sealed's Army Card are moved to this Army Card. Any Shade that cannot be placed is removed from the game.
ability_2_desc: If a Shade of Nokthara inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's Unique Hero with a normal attack, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from any one Undead Army Card you control.
ability_3_desc: Shades of Nokthara are never attacked when leaving an engagement. Shades of Nokthara may move through spaces occupied by opponent's figures without becoming engaged, but may not end their movement on an occupied space.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Shades of Nokthara's movement, ignore elevations. Shades of Nokthara may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Shade of Nokthara starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Three highly mobile attack 3 bodies appearing automatically on the base hero's death effectively refunds the hero, making the add-on cost hard to separate from the base card's own value.

name: Ember Wisps
ability_1_desc: After an Ember Wisp attacks, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or lower, destroy that Ember Wisp.
ability_2_desc: When an Ember Wisp is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die for each figure that was adjacent to it. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Elemental figures are never affected by Cinder Burst.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for an Ember Wisp's movement, ignore elevations. An Ember Wisp may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Ember Wisp starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Attack 5 flying squad figures are enormous offense, but a 40% self-destruct chance per attack and a retaliatory death burst make the card's real damage output and trade math very hard to model.

name: Ashigaru Hoka
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. When attacking with Fire Bomb Special Attack, choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Fire Bomb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After an Ashigaru Hoka attacks with Fire Bomb Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, destroy that Ashigaru Hoka.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ashigaru Hoka, if it is adjacent to another Ashigaru figure you control, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: A cheap common hero that throws a 4-dice area attack is the most efficient damage-per-point in the format if it survives, so the 15% self-destruct and 1 life must carry the entire discount.

name: Sylvane Greenlash
ability_1_desc: Sylvane Greenlash cannot move and attack on the same turn.
ability_2_desc: When Sylvane Greenlash attacks a figure at Range 5 or greater, the defending figure cannot roll more than 3 defense dice against that attack.
ability_3_desc: If Sylvane Greenlash is attacked while adjacent to a tree, a bush, or a Dryan figure you control, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Sylvane Greenlash takes no damage from that attack.
design_note: Range 8, attack 5, and a defense cap gut high-defense heroes from across the map, but the value hinges almost entirely on how often terrain lets the 40% dodge apply to a 2-life body.

name: Vector-Null
ability_1_desc: Range 9. Attack 6. Vector-Null cannot move and use the Siege Battery Special Attack on the same turn. Figures who are not adjacent to Vector-Null roll 1 fewer defense die when defending against the Siege Battery Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Vector-Null in which it used the Siege Battery Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, Vector-Null receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: If Vector-Null did not move on its most recent turn, add 1 to its Defense Value until the end of your next turn.
design_note: A 6-dice range 9 barrage that pierces cover is enormous damage, but the no-move restriction, self-wound roll, and 2 life make it a static target that can be charged or sniped off a hill.

name: Tindermask Bombardier
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the targeted figure are also affected by the Firebomb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. If a Tindermask Bombardier is within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure, that Bombardier is also affected by the Firebomb Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: When a Tindermask Bombardier is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die for each figure adjacent to it. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: A Tindermask Bombardier cannot move and use the Firebomb Special Attack on the same turn unless it begins its turn on a road space.
design_note: Common heroes are normally cheap, but a stackable multi-target 4-dice blast with a death explosion gives one-life figures disproportionate board impact.

name: Cinderhusk Revenant
ability_1_desc: When this Cinderhusk Revenant is destroyed, each figure adjacent to it receives 1 wound. Figures adjacent to this Cinderhusk Revenant that are immune to fire damage are not affected by Combusting End.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's figure moves out of a space adjacent to this Cinderhusk Revenant, after that figure's move you may move this Cinderhusk Revenant up to 2 spaces. It may only end this movement on an empty space adjacent to an enemy figure.
ability_3_desc: This Cinderhusk Revenant cannot be healed, and cannot receive more than 1 wound from any single attack.
design_note: One life with attack 6, an unavoidable death burst, and a hard cap of 1 wound per attack means its survivability is set entirely by how many separate attack rolls an opponent can make each round.

name: Sergeant Halden Roe
ability_1_desc: Sergeant Halden Roe is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A completely vanilla 5-life 4/4 melee hero whose single defensive-mobility power gives almost nothing to hang extra points on, so it defines the baseline curve.

name: Vex-7 Rail Sentry
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When a Vex-7 Rail Sentry attacks with the Rail Pulse Special Attack, it may not move on the same turn.
design_note: A cheap common hero whose special attack outranges its normal attack but forbids moving, so the drawback and the upgrade nearly cancel and the card sits awkwardly on the low end of the scale.

name: Gorb the Bruiser
ability_1_desc: When this Gorb the Bruiser attacks, it may attack one additional time.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for this Gorb the Bruiser's movement, double the height of each level it climbs.
design_note: Double Attack on a large 5-life body with no offsetting drawback pushes an otherwise plain bruiser toward triple-digit territory, and the uncommon-hero stacking makes the per-card cost sensitive.

name: Sir Aldric Thorne
ability_1_desc: Sir Aldric Thorne is never attacked when he leaves an engagement.
ability_2_desc: Sir Aldric Thorne adds 1 to his Defense Value when attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure.
design_note: A plain 4-life melee knight whose only powers are defensive conveniences, so he must be priced almost entirely off raw stats.

name: Wind Lancers of Sumara
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Wind Lancer of Sumara's movement, ignore elevations. A Wind Lancer may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Wind Lancer of Sumara is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If a Wind Lancer of Sumara moves at least 4 spaces this turn before attacking, add 1 die to its attack for that attack.
design_note: Flying plus a charge bonus die on an Attack 3 / Defense 2 common squad sits right between the cheap melee squads and the premium flyers.

name: Skreel Duskwing
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Skreel Duskwing's movement, ignore elevations. Skreel Duskwing may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Skreel Duskwing is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: Skreel Duskwing is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Flying and Disengage together grant near-total mobility on a fragile 2-life common hero, so the powers are worth more than the statline suggests.

name: Seraphine Vael
ability_1_desc: All figures you control that are adjacent to Seraphine Vael add 1 to their Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent attacking figure.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Vael's movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine Vael may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine Vael starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying plus range 5, attack 4 and a friendly defensive aura stack into a support-and-damage package whose aura value swings wildly with squad count.

name: Seraphine Vael (variant)
ability_1_desc: All figures you control that are adjacent to Seraphine Vael (variant) add 1 to their Defense Value when defending against a non-adjacent attacking figure.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Seraphine Vael (variant)'s movement, ignore elevations. Seraphine Vael (variant) may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Seraphine Vael (variant) starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: Seraphine Vael (variant) cannot move and attack in the same turn. After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you must choose to either move with Seraphine Vael (variant) or attack with Seraphine Vael (variant), but not both.
design_note: A ranged hero loses less from 'no move and attack' than a melee one, and her aura still works on a move-only turn, making the drawback softer than it reads.

name: Kael Tessarin
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. Figures attacked by Mindshock Special Attack cannot roll any defense dice against this attack. Mindshock Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Once per turn, after moving and before attacking with Kael Tessarin, you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Kael Tessarin and move that figure 1 space. You may not move that figure to a space more than 1 level higher or lower than the space it occupied, and you may not move that figure onto a space it cannot normally occupy. A figure moved by Telekinetic Shift does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: An unblockable 2-die special attack plus free repositioning of enemies or allies gives reliable chip damage and glyph/engagement control that is hard to convert into dice math.

name: Kael Tessarin (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. Figures attacked by Mindshock Special Attack cannot roll any defense dice against this attack. Mindshock Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Once per turn, after moving and before attacking with Kael Tessarin (variant), you may choose one small or medium figure within 4 clear sight spaces and move that figure 1 space. You may not move that figure to a space more than 1 level higher or lower than the space it occupied, and you may not move that figure onto a space it cannot normally occupy. A figure moved by Telekinetic Shift does not take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, and before taking a turn with Kael Tessarin (variant), roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent takes that entire turn with Kael Tessarin (variant) instead of you, using all of his powers. If there is more than one opponent, the opponent to your left takes the turn. That opponent may not move Kael Tessarin (variant) off the battlefield.
design_note: A 30% chance per revealed Order Marker of handing an unblockable attacker to the opponent is a swingy, potentially self-destructive drawback that is far worse than simply losing the turn.

name: Marrek Thal
ability_1_desc: When Marrek Thal rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if he receives no wounds from that attack, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Marrek Thal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Attack 5 with a punishing counter power on a 6-life hero sits awkwardly between mid-tier and premium melee heroes.

name: Marrek Thal (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Marrek Thal rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, if he receives no wounds from that attack, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Marrek Thal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on Marrek Thal and before taking his turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, an opponent takes Marrek Thal's turn this turn instead of you, moving and attacking with him as if he were his own figure. If there is more than one opponent, the opponent with the fewest figures on the battlefield takes the turn. Marrek Thal cannot be attacked by the figures of the opponent taking his turn during that turn.
design_note: A 30% chance per order marker of handing a high-attack melee hero to the enemy also wastes the order marker, so the discount must cover both lost tempo and self-inflicted damage.

name: Grimhold the Unbroken
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Grimhold the Unbroken add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grimhold the Unbroken, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Grimhold the Unbroken is never moved, placed, or affected by an opponent's special power that would move him from the space he occupies.
design_note: A slow, high-defense aura anchor whose self-repair and wound-soaking both scale with how long he survives, making his real durability hard to convert into a flat cost.

name: Grimhold the Unbroken (variant)
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) add 1 to their defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Grimhold the Unbroken (variant), you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) is never moved, placed, or affected by an opponent's special power that would move him from the space he occupies.
ability_4_desc: Wound markers may never be removed from Grimhold the Unbroken (variant)'s Army Card. Grimhold the Unbroken (variant) cannot be healed by any special power, glyph, or other game effect.
design_note: The added drawback silently turns his own Stone Mending 14 into a dead power, so the price drop must cover both the lost external healing and a printed ability that can never trigger.

name: Thessaly Windshear
ability_1_desc: If Thessaly Windshear used her Flying special power this turn and moved at least 4 spaces before attacking, she rolls 2 additional attack dice on her first normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Thessaly Windshear, you may choose one small or medium figure you control adjacent to Thessaly and move that figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure may not attack after moving with Windshear Escort.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Thessaly Windshear's movement, ignore elevations. Thessaly Windshear may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thessaly Windshear starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Move 7 with Flying plus a conditional +2 attack dice diving bonus and a free ally reposition stack three value sources that are hard to separate.

name: Thessaly Windshear (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Thessaly Windshear used her Flying special power this turn and moved at least 4 spaces before attacking, she rolls 2 additional attack dice on her first normal attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Thessaly Windshear, you may choose one small or medium figure you control adjacent to Thessaly and move that figure up to 3 spaces. The chosen figure may not attack after moving with Windshear Escort.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Thessaly Windshear's movement, ignore elevations. Thessaly Windshear may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Thessaly Windshear starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_4_desc: While there are one or more wound markers on this Army Card, Thessaly Windshear cannot use her Flying special power.
design_note: The drawback only bites after the first wound, but it also silently switches off Diving Assault, so its cost is larger than it first reads.

name: Grubhollow Sappers
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. After attacking with Sapper's Charge Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, the attacking Grubhollow Sapper receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Grubhollow Sapper's movement, that Sapper may move through spaces occupied by small or medium figures without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After a Grubhollow Sapper you control is destroyed, you may move each other Grubhollow Sapper you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
design_note: A 4-figure common squad with a self-wounding ranged special attack and free mobility tricks sits awkwardly between cheap melee chaff and real ranged squads.

name: Grubhollow Sappers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 2. After attacking with Sapper's Charge Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, the attacking Grubhollow Sapper receives one wound.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Grubhollow Sapper's movement, that Sapper may move through spaces occupied by small or medium figures without becoming engaged.
ability_3_desc: After a Grubhollow Sapper you control is destroyed, you may move each other Grubhollow Sapper you control up to 1 space. These spaces may be up to 1 level higher or lower.
ability_4_desc: When a Grubhollow Sapper you control is engaged with 2 or more opponent's figures, subtract 1 from that Sapper's Defense Value.
design_note: Losing a die from an already thin defense of 2 matters most exactly when swarmed, which is how common squads usually die.

name: Sir Callum of Greyhold
ability_1_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. When attacking with Lance Thrust Special Attack, Sir Callum of Greyhold is not considered engaged with the figure he attacks.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Callum of Greyhold adds 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A plain tanky melee hero whose reach-2 special attack dodges engagement rules, making his defensive value easy to over- or under-rate before any aura is added.

name: Sir Callum of Greyhold (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. When attacking with Lance Thrust Special Attack, Sir Callum of Greyhold is not considered engaged with the figure he attacks.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Sir Callum of Greyhold adds 1 die to his defense.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Sir Callum of Greyhold add 1 die to their defense. Auras named Banner of Greyhold Aura 1 do not stack.
design_note: The identical knight plus a 4-space army-wide defense aura, which is worth far more alongside a cheap squad swarm than it is in a hero-heavy army, so the premium over the base card is hard to pin down.

name: Sentinel Kryx-9
ability_1_desc: If Sentinel Kryx-9 did not move on his turn, add 1 to his Range Value and add 1 die to his normal attack for that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of Sentinel Kryx-9's turn, if there are 1 or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Sentinel Kryx-9's Army Card.
design_note: A low-move ranged hero whose damage is only good when he stands still, and whose 25% self-heal is worth much more in a defensive build than an aggressive one.

name: Sentinel Kryx-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: If Sentinel Kryx-9 did not move on his turn, add 1 to his Range Value and add 1 die to his normal attack for that turn.
ability_2_desc: At the end of Sentinel Kryx-9's turn, if there are 1 or more wound markers on his Army Card, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 wound marker from Sentinel Kryx-9's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Sentinel Kryx-9 add 1 to their Move Value. A figure may not add more than 1 to its Move Value for Tactical Uplink Aura.
design_note: A move aura granted by a Move 4 figure who wants to stay stationary is awkwardly self-conflicting, making the buff easy to overvalue.

name: Vanguard Model K-77
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. Whether or not the defending figure receives any wounds, subtract 2 from that figure's Move value until the next time you reveal an Order Marker. Suppressive Volley Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: If Vanguard Model K-77 is attacked with a normal attack by a figure that is not adjacent to him, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, Vanguard Model K-77 receives no wounds from that attack.
design_note: Range 6 with only Attack 3 plus a soft-control special attack makes the base figure's damage output unimpressive while its Defense 5 and Deflector Shield make it very hard to remove.

name: Vanguard Model K-77 (variant)
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. Whether or not the defending figure receives any wounds, subtract 2 from that figure's Move value until the next time you reveal an Order Marker. Suppressive Volley Special Attack does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: If Vanguard Model K-77 is attacked with a normal attack by a figure that is not adjacent to him, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, Vanguard Model K-77 receives no wounds from that attack.
ability_3_desc: All friendly figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Vanguard Model K-77 add 1 die to their attack when attacking with a normal attack.
design_note: An attack-die aura on a durable long-range figure is easy to keep active all game, and it scales with the number of friendly attack rolls rather than with this hero's own stats.

name: Sylvani Thornwhisper
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sylvani Thornwhisper, you may choose an opponent's figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sylvani and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, the chosen figure may not move until the end of the round. A figure affected by Bramble Snare cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
ability_2_desc: Sylvani Thornwhisper may move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A 65%-reliable no-move lockdown on any figure within 4 spaces is close to a soft Cyberclaw on demand, so the threshold does most of the pricing work here.

name: Sylvani Thornwhisper (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Sylvani Thornwhisper, you may choose an opponent's figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Sylvani and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure may not move until the end of the round. A figure affected by Bramble Snare cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
ability_2_desc: Sylvani Thornwhisper may move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: At 30% success the snare becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, so the card must be priced nearer to its mediocre melee stat line.

name: Overseer Tallow-9
ability_1_desc: At the start of the round, after rolling for initiative, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker from an Army Card you control and place it on another Army Card you control. You may not place more than 3 Order Markers on the same Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Any Unique Soulborg you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Overseer Tallow-9 adds 1 to its Range Value.
design_note: Order-marker manipulation is one of the strongest effects in the game, so the gap between a 65% and a 30% Recalibrate swings the price far more than the shared stat line suggests.

name: Overseer Tallow-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: At the start of the round, after rolling for initiative, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker from an Army Card you control and place it on another Army Card you control. You may not place more than 3 Order Markers on the same Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Any Unique Soulborg you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Overseer Tallow-9 adds 1 to its Range Value.
design_note: With only a 30% chance per round the marker fix is a lucky bailout, leaving a solid but unspectacular Range 6 hero with a small Soulborg aura.

name: Ashmane Prowler
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmane Prowler, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, this Ashmane Prowler may move up to 4 additional spaces and add 1 die to its attack this turn. If you roll a 1, this Ashmane Prowler cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Add 1 to the Attack Value of each Ashmane Prowler you control who is adjacent to at least one other Ashmane Prowler you control.
design_note: An uncommon hero that can stack Pack Hunter with a frequently-successful pounce scales superlinearly as you buy more copies, making the single-card price ambiguous.

name: Ashmane Prowler (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmane Prowler, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, this Ashmane Prowler may move up to 4 additional spaces and add 1 die to its attack this turn. If you roll a 1, this Ashmane Prowler cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Add 1 to the Attack Value of each Ashmane Prowler you control who is adjacent to at least one other Ashmane Prowler you control.
design_note: The same 1-in-20 whiff penalty now sits alongside only a 30% success rate, so the drawback eats into the power's value and the price should drop noticeably.

name: Ashvale Pikewardens
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, an Ashvale Pikewarden you control adds 1 defense die for each other Ashvale Pikewarden you control adjacent to it, to a maximum of 1 additional defense die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's Small, Medium, or Large figure moves adjacent to an Ashvale Pikewarden you control, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, the moving figure receives 1 wound. You may use Set Spears only once per opponent's figure per turn, and never on a figure that was already adjacent at the start of that turn.
design_note: A vanilla 3/3 melee common squad whose cheap free-swing power and adjacency defense both scale with how many figures survive, making its true value sensitive to squad-wipe rates.

name: Ashvale Pikewardens (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, an Ashvale Pikewarden you control adds 1 defense die for each other Ashvale Pikewarden you control adjacent to it, to a maximum of 1 additional defense die.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's Small, Medium, or Large figure moves adjacent to an Ashvale Pikewarden you control, you may roll 1 attack die. If you roll a skull, the moving figure receives 1 wound. You may use Set Spears only once per opponent's figure per turn, and never on a figure that was already adjacent at the start of that turn.
ability_3_desc: Ashvale Pikewardens (variant) cannot be bonded with. Ignore all special powers on other Army Cards that would allow you to take a turn with, or move, Ashvale Pikewardens (variant). You may take a turn with Ashvale Pikewardens (variant) only by revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card.
ability_4_desc: Ashvale Pikewardens (variant) are never affected by an opponent's special powers that would cause them to be moved or to take a turn out of order.
design_note: Losing all bonding access is a severe drawback for a Jandar Soldier squad that would otherwise ride Soldier bonding heroes, but the added immunity to opposing turn-stealing powers partly offsets it, so the discount is hard to size.

name: Emberjaw Hounds
ability_1_desc: When an Emberjaw Hound you control attacks an opponent's figure that is engaged with at least 2 other Emberjaw Hounds you control, add 1 die to that attack.
ability_2_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Emberjaw Hounds may add 2 to their height. Emberjaw Hounds do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: Move 7 with leaping mobility and a conditional fourth attack die pushes a fragile defense-2 common squad well above baseline melee rates, but only when all four figures are alive and swarming.

name: Emberjaw Hounds (variant)
ability_1_desc: When an Emberjaw Hound you control attacks an opponent's figure that is engaged with at least 2 other Emberjaw Hounds you control, add 1 die to that attack.
ability_2_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Emberjaw Hounds may add 2 to their height. Emberjaw Hounds do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
ability_3_desc: After an Emberjaw Hound (variant) you control attacks, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, that Emberjaw Hound (variant) receives 1 wound. Roll separately for each Emberjaw Hound (variant) that attacks this turn, after that figure's attack is resolved.
design_note: A flat 25% chance to destroy each attacking figure effectively taxes the squad's own offense, and because these are 1-life figures the drawback compounds with their low defense far faster than a simple point subtraction suggests.

name: Sablewood Scouts
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, a Sablewood Scout adds 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: After a Sablewood Scout you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack and receives no wounds, you may move that Sablewood Scout up to 2 spaces. A Sablewood Scout moving with Ranger's Withdrawal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A cheap-statted ranged squad whose free repositioning after every clean defense roll quietly converts a low Attack Value into strong board control, which is hard to weigh against its fragility.

name: Sablewood Scouts (variant)
ability_1_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, a Sablewood Scout adds 1 die to its defense.
ability_2_desc: After a Sablewood Scout you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack and receives no wounds, you may move that Sablewood Scout up to 2 spaces. A Sablewood Scout moving with Ranger's Withdrawal is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_3_desc: Whenever you move a Sablewood Scout, it must end its movement closer to the nearest enemy figure than it was at the start of that movement, if possible. To determine the nearest enemy figure, count the fewest number of spaces to each enemy figure, ignoring elevation. Ranger's Withdrawal movement is also affected by Blood Trail Compulsion.
design_note: Forcing a Range 5 squad to close the gap every turn both wastes its range and drags it out of the non-adjacent bonus of Thornbrush Vigil, so the drawback compounds twice over.

name: Rogue Unit XR-9
ability_1_desc: When Rogue Unit XR-9 attacks a figure at Range 5 or greater with a normal attack, add 1 to his Attack Value.
ability_2_desc: When you reveal an Order Marker on this card, before taking a turn with Rogue Unit XR-9, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 5 or lower, the opponent of your choice takes this turn with Rogue Unit XR-9 instead, moving him and attacking with him as if they controlled this Army Card. That opponent may not attack their own figures with Rogue Unit XR-9.
design_note: A 25% chance per revealed Order Marker of handing a Range 7, Attack 4 sniper to the opponent is a rare, game-swinging drawback whose cost is hard to weigh against three otherwise-premium turns.

name: Rogue Unit XR-9 (variant)
ability_1_desc: When Rogue Unit XR-9 attacks a figure at Range 5 or greater with a normal attack, add 1 to his Attack Value.
design_note: With the control-loss clause deleted and nothing added, this is a clean long-range hero whose price must be set purely on stats plus a modest conditional attack bonus.

name: Sunspear Zealots
ability_1_desc: If a Sunspear Zealot moves 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 1 die to its attack for the rest of that turn.
ability_2_desc: When a Sunspear Zealot attacks, it must attack the enemy figure that is the fewest spaces away from it, ignoring elevation and line of sight. If two or more enemy figures are tied for the fewest spaces away, you may choose which of those figures the Sunspear Zealot attacks.
design_note: Forced targeting on a cheap 4-figure charging squad both blunts focus-fire plans and hands opponents a screening trick, which is easy to under- or over-discount.

name: Sunspear Zealots (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Sunspear Zealot moves 3 or more spaces on its turn, add 1 die to its attack for the rest of that turn.
design_note: Stripped of Blind Fervor, this is a plain Attack 4-on-the-charge common squad, so the whole price gap between the twins is the cost of choosing your own targets.

name: Mistwalker Scouts
ability_1_desc: When a Mistwalker Scout that has not moved this turn attacks an enemy figure that is 3 or more spaces away, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Mistwalker Scout's movement, all tree spaces and jungle spaces are considered level terrain. Mistwalker Scouts do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
ability_3_desc: When revealing an order marker on the Mistwalker Scouts Army Card, before taking a turn with the Mistwalker Scouts, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 5 or lower, remove that order marker and you may not take a turn with the Mistwalker Scouts this turn.
design_note: A 25% chance to waste an entire order marker on a 3-figure Range 5 squad is a turn-economy tax rather than a combat penalty, making its point discount unusually hard to pin down.

name: Mistwalker Scouts (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Mistwalker Scout that has not moved this turn attacks an enemy figure that is 3 or more spaces away, add 1 die to its attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Mistwalker Scout's movement, all tree spaces and jungle spaces are considered level terrain. Mistwalker Scouts do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.
design_note: Reliable Range 5, Attack 4 stationary fire from three unique figures must be valued near the top of the ranged-squad band, and the gap to its Mistbound twin is pure order-marker reliability.
